correctness.rationale: The Fibonacci addition identity gives integrality: the interior entry (m,k) equals F_(m-k+1) times the entry (m-1,k-1) plus F_(k-1) times the entry (m-1,k), from boundary 1. The Fibonacci matrix has off-diagonal zero modulo 3 exactly at multiples of four; Q^4=-(I+3C), and cubing successively increases the valuation of the correction by one and preserves its normalized off-diagonal modulo 3. Raising to a power prime to 3 proves v3(F_(4j))=1+v3(j). Partitioning the factorial quotient by residues of m,k modulo four gives ten residue pairs with ordinary binomial valuation and six with an extra 1+v3(R), the latter only when R=Q-K>0. In adding K and R the base-three transfer has rows (6,3u),(3,6u) and must end without overflow. Before the first nonzero digit of R, carry remains zero and each zero has total weight 3u; first exit weights are (3,3u). Thus the resolvents give (1-6uz)/Delta for the ordinary term and z(3,3u)(I-zT)^(-1)(1,0)^T/(1-3uz)=3z/Delta for the trailing-zero term. Their weighted sum gives the claimed all-level GF. Specializing to u=0 gives 10·6^L; at L>=2 only 6uH_(L-1) contributes to degree L, so its coefficient is 18·6^(L-1) from level one. Independent recursion computing actual integral entries gives the same complete histograms at L=0 through 3.
residual_risks: The all-level result is proved by the transfer, not extrapolated from the replay; no higher-modulus unit residues are determined.

originality.rationale: The evaluated whole-triangle distribution at all levels is the supported distinct claim. The same-size mod-three fractal already determines the nonzero pattern, and the 2018 Theorem 11(iii) already gives the entrywise reduction used by the proof, exactly at p=3 after specialization. Neither examined result enumerates the complete block of valuations. The block summation with both the carries and the trailing zeros and their explicit rational combination is the contribution assessed here.
residual_risks: Knuth–Wilf full text unavailable in the checked routes; no claim of whole-paper exclusion.
A less searchable equivalent generalized triangle enumeration may exist. The novelty decision does not assert exhaustive historical priority.

value.rationale: The scales are those of the classical mod-three Fibonomial fractal, not arbitrary cutoffs. The whole positive-valuation spectrum makes exact prime-power frequency queries and the sharp top stratum available from a short recurrence rather than coefficient-by-coefficient computation. The previously known entrywise valuation and valuation-zero pattern are not counted as the contribution.
residual_risks: No claim of residues modulo higher powers or distributions at other primes.
